is across the SW/NE monsoon axis.
5. Oxygen-clean area around V-102, PV-122 station and O2 lines: no oil, grease or flammables; SS316L cleaned for

7. Line numbers from PSA-PID-001/002 rev A; vent and relief tails are not numbered on rev A (engineering query).
